Title: Fast Reaction, IotK and Shimulo Deception

Messages.Author: vermillian
Messages.Body:
Question 1.) Some one blocks, plays IotK during combat, an illusion
dukes it out and then combat ends... can I then play fast reaction by
another one of my blocking minions, or was that needed to be played
directly after IotK?

Question 2.) I shim over to another vampire after blocking... after
that combat, the original 'blocking' vampire is capable of playing
fast reaction, yes?

~SV

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
vermillian wrote:
> Question 1.) Some one blocks, plays IotK during combat, an illusion
> dukes it out and then combat ends... can I then play fast reaction by
> another one of my blocking minions, or was that needed to be played
> directly after IotK?

Neither. FR cannot be played after the IotK combat (either the blocker
or the acting minion is absent) nor before (since IotK has set up an
impending combat).

> Question 2.) I shim over to another vampire after blocking... after
> that combat, the original 'blocking' vampire is capable of playing
> fast reaction, yes?

Probably not, but I don't know what "shim" is. Is suspect it involves
one of the new combatants being neither acting nor blocking however.

> vampire, and has Auspex, at any given level. Now another minion,
> controlled by me, who is a vampire and who has Chimestry, lets say at

Chimerstry. Two r's. Not English, though, AFAIK, so you're off the hook there.

"let's" has an apostrophe in English, though. :-)

> the superior level, plays SHIMULO DECEPTION, and now is the blocking

That's Shilmulo Deception, BTW. "Shilm", not "Shim".
Perhaps adding to my previous confusion. :-)

> mininion. After this combat, can the original vampire play Fast
> Reaction?

Per card text, yes. Fast Reaction can be played "after a combat between a
blocking minion you control other than this vampire and the acting minion."

The vampire who is not this vampire is a blocking minion you control and
has just completed combat with the acting minion.
